title: Add Game: UI to create custom game profiles
description: Game toolbar/Settings "Add Game..." dialog that writes <config>/profiles/<name>.json for any Source game with a gameinfo.txt; prefill from gameinfo/FGDs/compile tools; optional tool_directory field in the profile JSON.
how_to_test: Automated: build/linux-clang-release/tests/apex_tests -tc='*suggestGameProfile*,*GameProfile*' and QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen build/linux-clang-release/apex_ui_tests -tc='*Add Game*,*custom game profile*' (all pass). Manual: run apex, Game toolbar > Games > Add Game..., Browse to a Source game folder holding gameinfo.txt (e.g. steamapps/common/Half-Life 2/hl2). Name, FGDs, vbsp/vvis/vrad, game exe and engine branch fill in; Save. Expected: the game appears and is selected in the Game picker, material/model browsers populate from its content, entity classes come from the FGDs, and ~/.config/Apex/Apex/profiles/<name>.json exists. Edit Game reopens it with the same values; Remove Game deletes the JSON and drops it from the picker.

history.note: Built: assets::suggestGameProfile + gameProfileFileName, optional tool_directory JSON field (tool fallbacks for non-Strata layouts), GameProfileDialog, Game toolbar 'Games' menu (Add/Edit/Remove/Open Profiles Folder) + Settings > Add Game. Tests: 4 new asset cases, 2 UI cases; full apex_ui_tests 218/218 pass (clang-release).
